details: Backbone of development: Modernizes agriculture, reduces heavy dependence on agricultural income, reduces poverty and unemployment.
Agglomeration Economies: Cost advantages gained when industries cluster near urban centers to utilize banking, transport, power, and market networks.
evidence_or_examples: Cotton textile cluster around Mumbai and Ahmedabad urban centers.

details: Textile Industry: Self-reliant and complete in value chain (fiber to garment); Cotton (Mumbai 1854), Jute (Hugli basin cluster in WB).
Sugar Industry: Seasonal nature; shifting from UP to Maharashtra due to higher sucrose content and successful cooperatives.
Iron & Steel Industry: Basic/Heavy industry; raw material ratio Iron ore : Coking coal : Limestone = 4 : 2 : 1. Concentrated in Chhota Nagpur Plateau.
Aluminum Smelting: Second major metallurgical industry; requires massive continuous electricity and cheap bauxite.
Chemicals & Fertilizers: Organic and inorganic chemicals; Nitrogenous (Urea), Phosphatic, and NPK fertilizers.
Information Technology & Electronics: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI); Bengaluru as Silicon Valley of India.
evidence_or_examples: STPI hubs generating 30% employment for women; Chhota Nagpur plateau holding majority steel plants.

details: Four Pollution Types: Air (toxic gases, smoke stacks), Water (industrial effluents), Thermal (hot water discharge into rivers), Noise (generators, machinery).
Effluent Treatment Stages: Primary (mechanical screening/sedimentation), Secondary (biological aeration), Tertiary (chemical recycling to zero discharge).
NTPC EMS ISO 14001: Model corporate strategy for ash utilization, ecological monitoring, and green belts around thermal power plants.
evidence_or_examples: NTPC power plants achieving high fly ash utilization and establishing environmental monitoring cells.
